svg.title: How it works: source, collect, check, store, deliver
svg.desc: Animated pipeline: public job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) are collected with Python, checked with dbt tests and pytest, stored in DuckDB and Parquet, and delivered through GitHub and Hugging Face. 1,500 job boards, about 9 minutes, every morning.
svg.text: 1,500 job boards · about 9 minutes · every morning at 07:41 UTC
